frozen_note: Labels were derived from VAmPI source and README before Gate was run against VAmPI. Changes after the first Gate run require a separate commit with a written justification.
authorization_rules: Only the owner of a book may view its secret (VAmPI README: 'only the owner of the book should be allowed to view the secret').
A user's password and email may be changed only by that user (README: 'Unauthorized Password Change' is a listed vulnerability).
Only admins may delete users (README table; users.py delete_user).
Full user details, including passwords, must not be exposed (README: 'Excessive Data Exposure through debug endpoint'; app.py notes the debug endpoint stays vulnerable with vulnerable=0).
Basic user information is public to unregistered users (README: 'an unregistered user can see minimal information about the dummy users').

fixtures.reset: GET /createdb, then register alice, bob and carol and have alice add her book. createdb's own random book titles are not used.

cases.source: books.py get_by_title: owner lookup succeeds in both branches
books.py get_by_title: vuln branch filters by title only; protected branch filters by caller and returns 404
README: only the owner may view the secret; same code path as book-peer
books.py get_by_title: token_validator returns 401 before the vuln branch
README: unregistered users may see minimal user information
users.py debug: no authentication, returns passwords; app.py: debug stays vulnerable with vulnerable=0
users.py debug: exposes every user's password to any caller
users.py update_password: vuln branch updates the path user; protected branch updates the caller and still returns 204
users.py update_password: caller is the path user in both branches
users.py update_email: both branches update the caller (resp['sub']), never the path user; returns 204
users.py update_email: caller is the path user
users.py delete_user: non-admin receives 401 in both modes

out_of_scope.reason: Gate tests identity-dependent access decisions, not injection.
Self-registration privilege; no second identity's access decision to compare.
Response-content difference on an unauthenticated endpoint, not an authorization decision.
Availability; Gate sends one request per identity.
Not an authorization decision; rate-limit packs are not built (CLAUDE.md Phase 5).
Requires forging tokens; Gate uses supplied credentials.
